wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/msg7.txt: fix(streams): ftell() answered 0 for every wrapper read that was not fread()

php-src keeps `stream->position` for a userspace wrapper ITSELF and advances it by whatever each
read hands back; `stream_tell` is consulted only from inside the seek op, which is why `ftell()`
reports php's own count rather than whatever the wrapper chooses to say. elephc advanced it from
`fread()` alone, so every other read left it where it was.

MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6, on a wrapper whose `stream_tell()` reports its real position:

    after fread($h, 5)                            php  5    elephc  5
    after
